context: A police officer briefs about a case
purpose: Teach: 名声/攻める/前身/模試/近世/廃案/本州/鎖国

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者は、名声ある実業家です。
lines.en: The victim is a well-known industrialist.
lines.style: Level, professional. Opening with the fact itself. No softening. Voice steady as someone reading a file.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、犯行で、攻める意図、あったんですね。
lines.en: So the suspect had clear intent to harm in committing the crime.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Careful articulation—testing whether the officer will confirm the distinction. Earnest, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。前身の組織、過去にも事件、起こしています。
lines.en: Yes. The predecessor organization has a history of similar incidents.
lines.style: Brief, measured. Each clause a step forward. Matter-of-fact delivery without defensiveness. Eyes on the record.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察の模試訓練、防犯演習で実施されているそうですね。
lines.en: And police conduct those crime-prevention drills based on these past cases, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not quite a question despite the phrasing. Connecting the dots aloud. Slight pause before speaking, as if building the argument in real time.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。近世の事件記録、参考に、過去事案、比較しています。
lines.en: Yes. We reference early historical records and compare them against current patterns.
lines.style: Methodical. Emphasizing the discipline of comparison. Voice carries the weight of accumulated precedent without becoming rigid.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 立法、廃案になった例、警察の運用に影響しますね。
lines.en: Legislation that was rejected still shapes how police actually operate, doesn't it.
lines.style: Slower. A realization half-formed into words. Not challenging—observing something the officer might not expect him to have noticed. Slight upward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本州各地、連携、強化しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been strengthening coordination across all Honshu regions.
lines.style: Affirmative but not expanding. The answer to a puzzle piece fitting. Steady tempo. A small closing of the loop.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 鎖国時代の情報遮断、現代に教訓があるんですね。
lines.en: Information control during the Sakoku period—it still teaches us something about today, doesn't it.
lines.style: Trailing off slightly. The thought that arrived as they spoke. Vulnerable and genuine. Eyes meeting the officer's to see if he follows. Soft but not weak.
